{{Quote|Corf Sarb's primary weapon is an agile mind, honed to vibroblade sharpness by many years as the unquestioned ruler of a small by flourishing crime syndicate. His soft-spoken manner cleverly disguises his ruthless methods of operation.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]|<ref name="WBC" />}}
'''Corf Sarb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Enu]], who lived during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Corf Sarb was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Deylerax]] in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]]. Sarb joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and embezzled from them in order to start his own criminal empire. Although a relatively minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], Sarb run a profitable [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation and several [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] establishments on Deylerax. On the charges of smuggling, accessory to murder of New Republic personnel, and racketeering, the New Republic posted a reward of 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Sarb's capture.<ref name="WBC" />

==Personality and traits==
Corf Sarb was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Near-Human]] [[Enu]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who was 1.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Sarb was extremely intelligent and did not pose much of a physical threat, although he was willing to kill to protect his interests.<ref name="WBC" />

==Skills and abilities==
Sarb was skilled in the use of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and could operate both ground and hover vehicles. He was also able to [[Astrogation/Legends|plot courses]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and repair [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Sarb was knowledgeable about [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure, especially in relation to Deylerax, and business practices with a specialty in accounting. He was also aware of the value of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Equipment==
Sarb carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], as well as a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corf Sarb was profiled in [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], a [[1993]] sourcebook released by [[West End Games]].
